hero.title:
One file.
The entire framework.
hero.subtitle: Zorux transforms a single app.yaml into REST API, Admin UI, Mobile (Expo), Desktop (Tauri), PWA, GraphQL, webhooks, jobs, auth with 35 OAuth providers, and more.

features.title: Everything a SaaS needs, native.
features.subtitle: No gems, no packages, no manual config. Each feature is built-in and works immediately.

zeroConfig.title: Zero Config
zeroConfig.desc: 1 YAML defines models, auth, database, plugins. No route files, migrations or manual config.

auth.title: Complete Auth
auth.desc: 35 OAuth providers, WebAuthn/Passkey, 2FA TOTP, Magic Link, OTP, API Keys, Organizations, OAuth Provider (IdP).

abac.title: ABAC + RBAC
abac.desc: Engine with expressions: ==, !=, >, in, matches, exists, &&, ||, derived roles, field-level security.

multiOutput.title: Multi-Output
multiOutput.desc: API + Admin + Mobile (Expo) + Desktop (Tauri) + PWA from the same schema.

plugins.title: NPM Plugins
plugins.desc: Any npm package works. Express, Hono, Passport — auto-detected via 12 adapters. No wrappers.

admin.title: Admin UI
admin.desc: Dashboard, CRUD, rich text, upload, email sandbox, feature flags, theme toggle, Turbo SPA.

realtime.title: Realtime
realtime.desc: WebSocket + Pub/Sub. Auto-push without external dependencies. Model topics.

graphql.title: GraphQL + Webhooks
graphql.desc: Auto-generated GraphQL. Webhooks with HMAC. Audit log. Feature flags. All native.

performance.title: Performance
performance.desc: ~6k req/s CRUD real. Login in 0.36ms. Prepared stmts and AST cached. Bun + Hono.

comparison.title: Zorux vs. other frameworks
comparison.subtitle: More native features than Rails, Laravel or Next.js. Less configuration than any alternative.

featuresPage.title: 47 native features
featuresPage.subtitle: Each feature is optional, lazy-loaded, and works without extra config.
featuresPage.oauth35Desc: Google, GitHub, Apple, Discord, Facebook, Twitter, LinkedIn, Microsoft, GitLab, Slack, Spotify, Twitch, Kakao, Naver, WeChat, TikTok, and 19 more
featuresPage.webauthnDesc: Passwordless authentication with biometrics (Touch/Face ID) and security keys
featuresPage.magicLinkDesc: Passwordless login via magic link or one-time code
featuresPage.apiKeysDesc: Key management with per-route rate limiting
featuresPage.orgsDesc: Multiple orgs per user, email invites, owner/admin/member roles
featuresPage.idpDesc: Let users login with your app via OAuth 2.0 + OpenID Connect
featuresPage.abacRbacDesc: Expressions: ==, !=, >, in, matches, exists, &&, ||, !, derived roles, field-level
featuresPage.crudDesc: REST routes for each model with pagination, sort, search, field filtering
featuresPage.graphqlDesc: Schema, queries and mutations generated from models
featuresPage.webhooksDesc: Auto-fire on CRUD with HMAC-SHA256 signing
featuresPage.auditLogDesc: Every operation logged: user, model, old/new values, IP
featuresPage.jobsDesc: Persistent queues with exponential retry and scheduling
featuresPage.softDeleteDesc: Logical deletion with restore and permanent delete
featuresPage.bulkDesc: CSV, JSON, XLSX — bulk import and export
featuresPage.dbProvidersDesc: SQLite, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Cloudflare D1, Supabase
featuresPage.cacheProvidersDesc: Memory, Redis, Upstash, Memcached, DynamoDB, SQLite, CF KV, CF DO
featuresPage.npmAutoDetectDesc: 12 adapters: Express, Hono, Passport, Koa, Fastify, and more
featuresPage.mobileExpoDesc: zorux gen mobile — React Native app with typed SDK per model
featuresPage.desktopTauriDesc: zorux gen desktop — Tauri v2 desktop application

install.title: Installation
install.success: Open http://localhost:3000 — API at /api, admin at /admin.

docs.title: Documentation
docs.introContent: Zorux is an AI-first full-stack framework. A single app.yaml generates your entire application — API REST, Admin UI, Mobile (Expo), Desktop (Tauri), PWA, GraphQL, webhooks, background jobs, auth with 35 OAuth providers, audit logs, feature flags, and more.
docs.philosophyP1: One source of truth. Your models, auth, permissions, and plugins are defined in one file. No separate route files, no migration scripts, no duplicated configuration.
docs.philosophyP2: Batteries included. 35 OAuth providers, ABAC policy engine, real-time WebSocket, background jobs, email, storage, cache, payments — all built-in.
docs.quickStartCmd:
npm install -g zorux
zorux new my-app --saas
cd my-app && zorux dev
docs.architectureP: Built on Bun runtime + Hono HTTP framework. One YAML → compiled models → database tables → CRUD routes → admin UI → GraphQL → plugins.
